description: Kartenlayer Geplante Trinkwasserschutzgebiete NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opengeodata.nrw.de. In order to ensure the long-term security of public water supply, water protection areas are established. Groundwater protection areas, otherwise drinking water dam protection areas, are demarcated for the water mostly extracted underground in North Rhine-Westphalia. Water protection areas are divided into zones. In this map layer, the planned drinking water protection areas are shown. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Map layer Planned drinking water protection areas NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include LANUK, NRW, Protected sites, Heilquelle, Kartenlayer, geplant. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
